name: GPU Backprojection with Global Memory Buffer
definition: A GPU-accelerated cone-beam CT reconstruction method that iterates over projection angles, loading each projection into global memory and accumulating contributions into a volume buffer using a single kernel launch per projection.
summary: GPU Backprojection with Global Memory Buffer reconstructs cone-beam CT by accumulating filtered projections into a global volume buffer, distinguished by using a single kernel launch per angle with one work-item per voxel.
